CONFIRM / ADOPT the icon system
  • Phosphor outline only, monochrome, simple geometric, ~1.5–2px (regular, not bold)
  • Size: UI ~24px, button leading ~18-20, pill marker ~14-16, subject ~16-20
  • Colour inherits context: ink neutral, indigo accent, semantic in pills
  • No canvas/tile for inline glyphs; tint tile only for the optional subject glyph
  • Subject-glyph SET is ours (DR-005), drawn in the Phosphor style
  • Fold-in cleanup: switch the filled icons in existing mocks to outline
SKIP (stays ours)
  • UC’s colourful 3D service icons — not our lane, breaks the budget
  • Fresha purple + semi-illustrative UI icons (tile idea only, restyled)
  • Filled / duotone icons — outline only (the pill live-dot is a dot, not an icon)
